Horizon NTM EPS on a consistent basis is $16.7-17.5. My central figure is $17.1.

thesis_break_reason: $160 is ~32% below spot, below the 52-week low of $164.27, ~13.2x today's NTM EPS and ~9.4x consistent Oct-2027 NTM EPS of $17.1. A flat year already needs ~13.9x, so compression alone cannot reach $160 while estimates hold. Trading there means the FY28/FY29 EPS path is breaking: a cut to 2027-28 hyperscaler capex, ASIC displacement, gross margin below the 71-72% trough, or a credit event in the extended-term receivables or the $105B guarantee.

compression_review.observed_compression: NTM P/E fell from ~40x (2025) to ~25x (Apr-2026) to ~19.5x now. Over the same period the stock rose ~25% and FY28 estimates rose ~24% in 90 days. The de-rating has come from estimates rising faster than the price, at a 52-week high. Nothing since 2026-09-30 shows a fresh, price-driven de-rating.
compression_review.panel_summary: Every agent assumes the multiple keeps compressing: 2.5-3.5 turns (-13% to -18%) to 16-17x, with base scenarios at 15.3-16x and bear cases at ~10.5-12x on cut EPS. None assumes a re-rating.

breakeven_multiple.definition: Multiple of Oct-2027 NTM EPS (Q3 FY28-Q2 FY29) at which the 2027-10-05 price equals $236.88 (dividends ~0.02% ignored)
breakeven_multiple.read: Consensus-like EPS has to arrive and the multiple has to fall a further ~29% (19.5x to ~13.9x) before today's buyer is flat. That is below AVGO/TSM (~20.6x) and far below any agent's base case, and it happens only if the market starts pricing a decline in FY29 EPS. That is the bear case, weighted 25-28% by agents, not compression on its own.

compression_review.verdict: No. Compression is real and will probably continue, but it should not change a small buy. At 19.5x NTM the panel already assumes 2.5-3.5 more turns of compression and still lands at a fair value of ~$263 with P(close >= spot) ~0.61. A loss needs an EPS break (capex digestion), not more de-rating. The real constraints are position size and overlap with AVGO, GOOGL and VST, plus the low conviction label below, not compression.

comps_review.basis: One consistent NTM basis: stockanalysis 'Forward PE' for NVDA and all peers, re-fetched 2026-10-05. That fits a time-weighted NTM given their 40-75% forecast growth, but could not be fully confirmed because FY2027 estimates are paywalled. Residual misalignment is at most ~1 quarter. summary: NVDA is on ~19.5x NTM EPS (Q3 FY27-Q2 FY28), a decade low. The 25x, 17x and 15x quotes are the same price on other EPS windows. In round 2 all five forecasters assume 2.5-3.5 more turns of compression (to 16-17x) and still reach fair values of $250-296. I reconcile to ~$263 with a ladder median of ~$261 and P(close >= spot) of ~0.61. A flat year needs ~13.9x on Oct-2027 NTM EPS, a further ~29% de-rating that only an EPS break would cause, so compression evidence should not change a small buy. Size it for the capex-digestion tail, which NVDA shares with AVGO, GOOGL and VST, and note that conviction stays low because expected excess return barely covers NVDA's 38% volatility.

sizing.entry: 2 tranches over ~6 weeks: half now, half after the Oct 27-30 hyperscaler capex guides and the ~Nov 17 Q3 FY27 print
sizing.overlap: AVGO (same AI-accelerator and hyperscaler-capex driver; a direct competitor for the same budgets), GOOGL (a top customer whose capex is NVDA revenue and whose TPU competes), VST (AI data-center power, same capex cycle). About $1.46k of ~$2.34k invested already rides AI capex.
sizing.reason: Fact-checks found no thesis problem, and compression is mostly priced in at 19.5x. But the downside scenario (2027-28 capex digestion with an EPS cut to ~12x) hits AVGO, GOOGL and VST at the same time, so ~5% (~$500) caps the AI-capex cluster at about a fifth of the portfolio. Liquidity is unlimited and there are no lock-up or listing issues. Event risk is concentrated in late October and mid-November, hence the staged entry. P(Sharpe beats SPY) is 0.47: an expected ~+11% at 38% vol gives a Sharpe of ~0.18-0.2, about the same as SPY's, so there is no clear edge.
sizing.conviction_label_reason: Old scale. The Sharpe-beat probability of 0.47 is essentially no edge. Round-2 checks confirmed the fundamentals but added nothing that raises expected return, the ladder is unchanged from the agents' mean, and the AI-capex overlap with AVGO, GOOGL and VST adds concentration rather than diversification.
